title: 基本句型
goal: 能区分五种基本句型，并安排双宾语、短语动词宾语及 there be 结构。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 写作

points.label: 按句型排出主语、谓语、宾语
正确放置双宾语和短语动词的宾语

body.p: 句型由动词决定：动词需要什么成分，句子就有什么成分。主谓句没有宾语。及物动词后面要有宾语。系动词后面是表语，说明主语。

body.box: The dough rose. / The baker weighed the dough. / The dough became soft.

body.p: 双宾语是两个宾语，一个是接受的人，一个是给出的东西。宾语补足语说明宾语的身份、状态或动作。The owner gave Lina a key 里，key 是给出的东西。The owner made Lina manager 里，manager 是 Lina 的身份。

cards.title: 五种基本句型
rows: 主谓
不及物动词后面没有宾语，可以加状语。
The customers waited outside.
主谓宾
及物动词后接动作涉及的对象。
The baker weighed the flour.
主系表
be、seem、become 等后接表语，说明主语。
The mixture became smooth.
主谓双宾语
先接受的人，后给出的东西。give 一类动词可以这样用。
The owner gave Lina a key.
主谓宾补
补足语说明宾语的身份或状态。
The owner appointed Lina manager.
动词的不同用法
同一个动词可以用在不同句型里，看它在本句里接什么。
The baker grew tired. / The baker grew herbs.

cards.title: 宾语的位置
rows: 双宾语
give、send、show 后面先接人，再接物。
The assistant showed me the invoice.
to 结构
先物，再用 to 引出接受者。
The assistant showed the invoice to me.
for 结构
buy、make 后面用 for 引出受益的人。
The baker made a sandwich for Lina.
不接双宾语的动词
explain 的用法是 explain something to someone。
The baker explained the recipe to Lina.
可分短语动词与名词
名词宾语放在小品词前面或后面都可以。
She turned the oven off. / She turned off the oven.
可分短语动词与代词
代词宾语放在动词和小品词之间。
She turned it off.
不可分动词短语
look after 这类短语，宾语放在介词后面。
She looked after the shop.

cards.title: there be 句型
rows: 存在
there 是引导词，be 后面是存在的事物。
There is a stain on the apron.
单数与复数
be 的单复数跟后面的名词一致。
There are stains on the apron.
时态
过去的存在用 was 或 were。
There was a crack in the bowl.
否定
not 放在 be 后面，也可以在名词前用 no。
There is not a clean tray. / There is no clean tray.
疑问
be 移到 there 前面，名词留在 there 后面。
Is there a clean tray?
与 have 的区别
there be 表示某处有某物，have 表示主语拥有某物。
There is a handle on the bowl. / The bowl has a handle.

body.box:
What did the locksmith do with the faulty lock?
She ______ ______ ______ ______ .
it / took / apart / for inspection / taking

body.p: take apart 是可分短语动词。it 是代词宾语，放在 took 和 apart 之间。for inspection 说明拆开的目的。taking 单独不能作谓语。

body.box: She took it apart for inspection.

body.p: 宾语换成名词时，She took the lock apart 和 She took apart the lock 都对。这时名词放在哪里，看词块怎么切分、句子已经给出了哪些词。

items.stem: Has the tailor's business changed?
items.why: The business 是主语，has been expanding 是谓语。expand 在这里不接宾语。been 前面要用 has，不用 is。

items.stem: How did the soup taste?
items.why: was 后面是表语 a little salty。描述味道用形容词 salty，salt 是名词。

items.stem: What did the cobbler repair?
items.why: repaired 后接宾语 the sole of my left shoe。repairing 不能单独作过去时的谓语。

items.stem: Why are the customers waiting?
items.why: There is 后接单数 a problem，所以不用 are。with the payment terminal 修饰 problem。

items.stem: How did the florist pack the vase?
items.why: put 是过去时谓语，it 是宾语，in a padded box 表示位置。putting 前面没有助动词，不能作谓语。

items.stem: What did the barista do with the grinder?
items.why: turn off 的代词宾语放在中间，即 turned it off。turning 不能单独作谓语。

items.stem: Did the watchmaker return the spare parts?
items.why: gave 后面先放间接宾语 me，再放直接宾语 a bag of spare screws。giving 前面没有助动词，不能作谓语。

items.stem: Who received the decorator's sketch?
items.why: sent 后面先接物 a copy，再用 to 引出接受的人 the client。sending 不能单独作谓语。

items.stem: What was the owner's decision about the new assistant?
items.why: made 后面是宾语 the assistant，再接形容词短语 responsible for the stockroom 作补足语。

items.stem: Did the repair shop explain the charge?
items.why: explain 后面先接解释的内容，再用 to 引出听的人。explained me the charge 是错的。

items.stem: What did the bookbinder do with the loose pages?
items.why: pick up 是可分短语动词，代词 them 放在 picked 和 up 之间。picking 不能单独作谓语。

items.stem: How many parcels were in the cart?
items.why: There were 后接复数 three parcels，所以不用 was。

items.stem: How has the candle shop performed?
items.why: Its sales 是复数主语，所以用 have，不用 has。have been increasing 是谓语，后面没有宾语。

items.stem: What did the engraver check?
items.why: checked 是谓语，the spelling of the surname 是宾语。checking 不能单独作过去时的谓语。

items.stem: How did the new soap feel?
items.why: felt 在这里是系动词，后面用形容词 smooth 作表语。smoothly 是副词，不能作表语。

items.stem: Who became supervisor at the print shop?
items.why: appointed 后面是宾语 Mira。supervisor of the evening shift 说明 Mira 的新身份，是宾语补足语。

items.stem: Is the cabinet empty?
items.why: There are 后接复数 several jars，所以不用 is。on the upper shelf 说明在哪里。

items.stem: What did the glassblower give the visitor?
items.why: gave 后面的 him 是接受的人，a sample of colored glass 是给出的东西。giving 不能单独作谓语。

items.stem: How did the leatherworker send the pattern?
items.why: 物 the pattern 紧跟 sent，接受的人由 to 引出。sending 前面没有助动词，不能作谓语。

items.stem: What did the upholsterer do with the worn cover?
items.why: take off 的代词宾语 it 放在 took 和 off 之间。taking 不能单独作谓语。

items.stem: Who is caring for the fish shop while the owner is away?
items.why: look after 不可分，宾语放在 after 后面。谓语是 is looking，looks 是多出的词块。

items.stem: Did the spice seller mention the difference between the two peppers?
items.why: explain 不接双宾语。宾语 it 紧跟动词，再用 to the customer 引出听的人。
